text_block_list.text:
While training on the uphill course with 
Rice Shower—

I spotted Mihono Bourbon silently doing 
practice runs on the slope.

The speed and power were astonishing, 
running with the intensity of an actual 
race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Halt. Warm-up, complete. Vitals, 
normal range. All components, nominal."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible... Even after running that 
much, she looks so relaxed...

Mihono Bourbon's run just now might serve 
as a good reference for Rice Shower.
choice_data_list:
Maybe I should ask about the training 
details?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? I-Is it really okay to do that...?
choice_data_list: I think you'll find it helpful.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, yeah. That was an amazing run, 
after all...!"

Having resolved herself, Rice Shower went 
over to hear what Mihono Bourbon had to 
say.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-That training just now was amazing... Do 
you always run like that?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That was just the warm-up routine. We'll 
be starting today's main training now.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-Warm-up!? All of that was just 
preparation...jo training!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Preparing to execute weighted uphill slope 
training. Attaching weights to target 
areas—

Mihono Bourbon suddenly began attaching a 
massive number of weights to her 
ankles...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Are you tackling the slope with all those 
on...?! With that many, isn't it super 
heavy?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It is heavy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah... I guess so...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"However, when simulating for maximum 
efficiency, this is the optimal weight."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to use one, Rice-san, please 
feel free to take the spare over there.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I will now proceed with the main process. 
Rechecking course conditions: optimal. 
Commencing load measurement."

Mihono Bourbon strapped on the weights 
just like that and started running up the 
slope course.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible...! Her speed hasn't dropped 
at all from earlier...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright... Maybe I'll try imitating it 
too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But... I don't think I can eat that 
much...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What should I do, Big Brotherâ
choice_data_list:
Let's give it a try within what we can 
handle!

Let's observe Mihono Bourbon's running 
style more closely

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What should I do, Big Sisterâ
choice_data_list:
Let's give it a try within what we can 
handle!

Let's observe Mihono Bourbon's running 
style more closely

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right. Rice will give it a 
try...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"First... maybe I'll try putting on just 
one..."

Saying that, Rice Shower picked up the 
weights—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-It's heavier than I thought...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But... I'm gonna take on the 
challenge...!

Afterward, Rice Shower strapped on the 
maximum weight she could run with and 
tackled the hill climb.

Though she seemed considerably fatigued, 
she appeared to have gained something 
worthwhile from pushing herself today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right. Maybe there's some 
kind of secret to it...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Observing... observing... Observing 
Bourbon-san..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *staaaaaaaaare...*

Rice Shower is watching Mihono Bourbon's 
powerful stride with intense focus...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...! C-Could it be—

Watching Mihono Bourbon's practice up 
close seemed to impart something valuable 
to Rice Shower.
